🎉 Barcelona · Thu 19 Nov

TODAY · Thu 19 Nov

1. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Today (hours not stated) · 📍 Bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 36 bars taking part · 945 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up
💶 €3.80 per tapa + drink
💬 A bar crawl with a map: you hop between neighbourhood bars, each serving one special tapa with a drink. One to do with friends you already have rather than a place to meet people. Runs until 29 Nov.
https://www.tapantoni.com/es/index.html

2. TARDET en Jaleo (tardeo)
🕘 Today 19:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Jaleo
📊 Listed on YouBarcelona's tardeo page · 23+ door policy
💶 €18
💬 The Thursday edition of the Tardet tardeo you already go to: an early club session, over by 23:00. Note the listing says 23+.
https://youbarcelona.com/es/p/tardeo-barcelona

3. Rituals pres. Pfirter + Insen + Kala Ros + PILIGN + Daija Showcase
🕘 Tonight 18:00 → 22:30 · 📍 Bridge 48
📊 250 interested on RA
💬 Early-evening techno in the round: four artists play an hour each with the crowd dancing around them. Headliner Pfirter is Argentine, though it is a techno crowd rather than an Argentine one. Done by 22:30.
https://ra.co/events/2574978

4. Els Llums de Sant Pau — opening night
🕘 Today (hours not stated) · 📍 Recinte Modernista de Sant Pau
📊 Featured by @planesenbarcelona (945 likes) and @barcelonasecreta · opens today, runs to 10 Jan
💶 €10
💬 A walk-through light installation in the modernist hospital grounds, themed on The Little Prince this year. A stroll with friends or a date, not a social; opening night, so expect queues.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df4_g09jU8J/

5. HOPE at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 92 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 House night on the 26th floor of the W hotel with views over the beach and a free guest list. Dressy, international crowd; an easy late option if the tardeo leaves you wanting more.
https://ra.co/events/2569462

TOMORROW · Fri 20 Nov

1. LOS40 Music Awards 2026
🕘 Fri 20:00 · 📍 Palau Sant Jordi
📊 Arena show at Palau Sant Jordi · listed from €59 on La Ganzúa
💶 From €59
💬 The biggest thing in the city on Friday: Spain's main pop radio awards gala, with a run of chart acts playing short sets. Check ticket availability before planning around it; I could not confirm what is left.
https://www.laganzua.net/conciertos/los40-music-awards-2026-barcelona-1016391

2. TARDET en Madame Tuset (tardeo)
🕘 Fri 19:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Madame Tuset
📊 Listed on YouBarcelona's tardeo page · 23+ door policy
💶 €18
💬 Friday's Tardet on Carrer Tuset, the same crew that runs the Sutton one (that is Saturday, 18:00). Early club session with a dressed-up local crowd; listing says 23+.
https://youbarcelona.com/es/p/tardeo-barcelona

3. Hop on The Top - The Last Jam - La Terrrazza 2026
🕘 Fri 19:00 → 23:59 · 📍 La Terrrazza
📊 513 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 €23–580
💬 Hip-hop, funk and soul party on the open-air La Terrrazza in Poble Espanyol, billed as their last one. Starts early and ends at midnight, so it works as its own tardeo or a warm-up.
https://ra.co/events/2568058

4. Sarrià Market
🕘 Fri (hours not stated) · 📍 Torre Amat, Sarrià
📊 945 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up
💶 Free entry
💬 A pop-up market of stalls in a Sarrià villa: browse, grab a drink, leave. A daytime wander with friends, not a place to meet people; I could not find how busy it gets.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df4_g09jU8J/

5. La Paloma presents: Quantic Dj set + Chica Acosta + Angela Blackburn
🕘 Fri 23:59 → 05:30 · 📍 La Paloma
📊 347 interested on RA
💬 Quantic DJs cumbia, soul and funk in La Paloma's old ballroom. The most danceable late night of the day and a friendlier crowd than the techno rooms.
https://ra.co/events/2571518
